title: Guiding Light
story:
A young boy lived in a small village near the hills.

One evening, his father asked him to go to a nearby house.

The path was dark and narrow.

There were no lights.

The boy felt afraid.

He asked, “How will I go alone?”

His father gave him a small lamp.

The boy said, “This light is too small.”

“It only shows a few steps ahead.”

His father smiled and said,

“Take the first step.
The light will guide you.”

The boy decided to trust his father.

He stepped forward.

The lamp lit the ground ahead.

He took another step.

And then another.

Each time he moved, the light moved with him.

He could not see the whole path.

But he could see enough for the next step.

Slowly, his fear faded.

His confidence grew.

Soon, he reached safely.

In life, we want to see everything ahead.

We want control.

But God gives light for the next step.

When we trust Him and move forward,

He guides us.

Step by step.

With wisdom.

With peace.
life_lesson:
You do not need to see the whole path.

Trust God for the next step, and He will guide you forward.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being my light in darkness.

Help me trust You when I cannot see the full path.

Give me courage to take each step in faith.

Remind me that Your guidance is enough.

Lead me with wisdom and fill me with peace.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you wait to see the full path before you act?

Can you trust God with just the next step today?

What is one small step of faith you can take now?
verse:
Your word is a lamp to my feet.
And a light to my path.
